title: License/data-use-terms snapshot capture in provenance flow
context: Provenance must capture an immutable snapshot of each source's license/terms, not a bare URL that can change. This task implements the decided snapshot format: committed local copy + SHA-256 hash + Wayback save URL, recorded in license.snapshotRef, plus dataUseConditions text where a DUA/registration applies. No partner is yet secured, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Implement license/terms snapshot capture (committed copy + SHA-256 + Wayback URL) wired into the provenance flow, as a PR.
acceptanceCriteria: Implements the decided format: committed local copy of the license/terms page + SHA-256 hash + Wayback save URL; license.snapshotRef records committed path, hash, Wayback timestamp; also captures dataUseConditions text where a DUA/registration applies. Bare URL insufficient.
Code MIT-licensed; tests + CI green; no credentials embedded.
